title: The Silent Observatory
incident: A ground-breaking exoplanet atmosphere dataset ('Proxima-d-Spectra') was permanently deleted from the offline RAID storage array hours before global announcement. The facility had no external internet connectivity due to a storm. The deletion was executed locally with root privileges.
centralQuestions: Whose cryptographic USB dongle authorized the terminal deletion?
Why was the server clock offset by 4 hours?
Did the deleted files exist on any offline backup tape?

timeline.event: Dr. Helena Cruz completes 8-hour telescope observation sequence.
Severe blizzard cuts satellite uplink to the mountain summit.
Server logs record local console login with Director's cryptographic token.
Low-level zero-wipe utility executed on primary and secondary storage volumes.
Day technician discovers all scientific data partitions unformatted.

suspects.name: Dr. Helena Cruz
suspects.motive: Discovered data had calculation flaws that would destroy her academic reputation.
suspects.statement: She claims she went to sleep in the staff dormitory at 1:30 AM.
relevant_evidence: Dormitory electronic latch logged her entry at 1:32 AM.
Her lab notebook had pages torn out.
supporting_evidence: Colleague saw her drinking chamomile tea in dorm kitchen at 1:40 AM.
suspicious_evidence: Her dormitory door sensor did not register an exit, but dorm ground-floor windows open.
suspects.uncertainty: Torn pages contained failed calibration equations, not fraud proof.
open_questions: Did she leave through the dormitory window?

suspects.name: Dr. Kenneth Shaw
suspects.motive: Co-author who was about to be removed from publication due to ethical inquiry.
suspects.statement: He says his cryptographic token was in his locked office desk drawer.
relevant_evidence: His physical token was used to execute the wipe at 3:30 AM.
supporting_evidence: Security camera shows him walking toward the library at 3:15 AM.
suspicious_evidence: Only he and his deputy had keys to the office.
suspects.uncertainty: A physical token can be removed and returned without leaving damage.
open_questions: Who had duplicate keys to Shaw's desk?

suspects.name: Mateo Silva
suspects.motive: Bribed by private satellite corporation wanting exclusive commercial patent rights.
suspects.statement: He says he was fixing the auxiliary diesel generator in the blizzard.
relevant_evidence: Snow boots wet and covered in rock salt.
supporting_evidence: Generator maintenance log shows voltage stabilization at 3:20 AM.
suspicious_evidence: The zero-wipe script used advanced disk geometry parameters only an engineer would know.
suspects.uncertainty: High-altitude technicians are all proficient in terminal administration.
open_questions: Could he clone the physical security dongle?

suspects.name: Dr. Nadia Patel
suspects.motive: Passed over for primary authorship despite writing the analysis software.
suspects.statement: She says she was in the spectroscopy darkroom processing calibration plates.
relevant_evidence: Darkroom door locked from inside with warning light on all night.
USB drive found in her boot.
suspicious_evidence: Darkroom shares a ventilation corridor with the server vault.
suspects.uncertainty: USB drive contained raw calibration curves, not the wiped dataset.
open_questions: Did she pass through the server vault duct?

witnesses.name: Night Operator Lucas
witnesses.statement: I smelled wet wool and saw a flashlight beam near the server door around 3:25 AM.
witnesses.limitations: Could not identify the person due to heavy snow parka.

witnesses.name: Facility Cook Rosa
witnesses.statement: Dr. Helena was asleep when I checked the dorm hall at 4:00 AM.
witnesses.limitations: Did not look inside Helena's bedroom.

evidence.title: Token Cryptographic Signature
evidence.description: PAM system logs confirm physical insertion of Director Shaw's USB Token #01 at 3:30 AM.
evidence.establishes: The Director's hardware key was inserted.

evidence.title: Parka Salt Stain Trace
evidence.description: High-concentration calcium chloride salt residue found on the server room keyboard spacebar.
evidence.establishes: Operator entered directly from the salted outdoor walkway without removing gloves.

evidence.title: Telescope Calibration Anomaly
evidence.description: The target exoplanet light curves showed instrumental sensor noise rather than atmospheric methane.
evidence.establishes: The breakthrough discovery was scientifically invalid due to sensor malfunction.

evidence.title: Director's Spare Key Location
evidence.description: Spare key to Shaw's desk was kept inside the first-aid kit in the common corridor.
evidence.establishes: Any staff member could access Shaw's desk and token.

evidence.title: Backup Tape Destruction
evidence.description: Physical magnetic tape LTO-8 was unspooled and crumpled inside the recycling bin behind the server.

redHerrings: Director Shaw's token was used, making him look like the saboteur, but the spare key in the first-aid kit made his token accessible to all staff.
Dr. Nadia's hidden USB drive was suspicious, but contained only thesis calibration models.

hiddenSolution.explanation: At 1:00 AM, Helena realized her exoplanet 'discovery' was a devastating sensor glitch that would destroy her international career. Desperate to prevent scientific humiliation, she exited her dorm window at 3:15 AM (leaving wet salt traces from the courtyard), retrieved Shaw's spare key from the first-aid kit, unlocked his token, executed the wipe, unspooled the backup tape, and returned through the window.
decisiveEvidence: E-D (Access to spare key in first-aid kit)
uncertainties: Whether the raw data can ever be recovered from magnetic remnants
hiddenSolution.alternativeExplanation: Mateo Silva wiped the servers on behalf of a commercial satellite company to prevent public domain release.

missingEvidence: Footprints in the snow outside Helena's dorm window (melted by blizzard)
Fingerprints on the unspooled tape cassette
rules: A cryptographic token proves hardware presence, not owner identity.
Scientific error can provide as powerful a motive as financial gain.
